a.xlink:title: Decodes captured stdout and process metadata into a collected ``max_sat_result(Status, Model, Properties)`` term, mapping reported literals back through an optional ``Variables`` table. ``Status`` is one of ``optimal``, ``satisfiable`` (a best-known solution of an interrupted anytime run that was accepted because ``Anytime`` is ``true``), ``unsatisfiable``, and ``unknown``.
